text:
Leo: quick post-deploy smoke — session-router synthetic sweep (eu-west) after canary. Observed p99 jump to ~3.1s from baseline ~220ms and intermittent 504 gateway errors on /v1/session for model v4.0.2-canary.

Deploy-bot: Canary run completed 9m ago; no automatic rollback.

Leo: tagging @nina @teg 44b propose HOLD further rollout and revert traffic to v4.0.1 until we triage.

Nina: ack. grabbing traces and heatmaps. Any host hotspots?

Teg: initial heatmap shows elevated tail on proxy-node-07 and proxy-node-09. Heap and socket wait look normal, but connection resets spike.

Ops-bot: ingesting synthetic log link: https://go.redwood/synth/job/3509998888-s1

Leo: smokebot please run a targeted sweep that pins to hosts 05..10 and the canary model header so we repro deterministically:
```
# targeted synth
curl -sS -X POST 'https://synth.redwood/check' -H 'x-region: eu-west' -H 'x-model: v4.0.2-canary' -H 'x-target-hosts: proxy-node-05,proxy-node-06,proxy-node-07,proxy-node-08,proxy-node-09,proxy-node-10' -d '{"path":"/v1/session","payload":"hello"}'
```
Run 100 requests, 10 concurrent.

Smokebot: starting job 3509998888-tgt1 (100 reqs, concurrency 10) against proxy-node-05..10.

Smokebot: job complete 4a4 results: 7/100 returned 504, p99=3100ms, p95=750ms, median=110ms. Failures concentrated on proxy-node-07 and proxy-node-09.

Teg: looks reproducible. Capturing tcpdump on node-07 and core on session-router process.

Leo: decision: pin traffic back to v4.0.1 (no DB or schema changes so safe) to avoid customer-facing errors. We'll keep canary artifacts for debugging. Nina, can you flip the routing?

Nina: applying pin now: set route weight v4.0.2-canary -> 0%, v4.0.1 -> 100%. ETA ~90s.

Deploy-bot: Traffic change applied 6a7 v4.0.2-canary weight=0%. v4.0.1 weight=100%. Canary artifact retained for debug.

Leo: runtime-eng, please collect strace + logs from proxy-node-07/09 and upload to s3. Commands that helped last time:
```
sudo pkill -SIGABRT -f session-router && sudo gdb -ex 'thread apply all bt' -ex quit --pid $(pgrep session-router) > /var/tmp/threads.txt
sudo tcpdump -w /var/tmp/proxy-node-07.pcap -i eth0 'port 443'
```

Runtime-eng: started collections. Will upload to s3://redwood-debug/3509998888/ after cores finish.

Teg: also enabling extended proxy logging for 10 minutes to capture handshake/keepalive failures.

Ops-bot: reminder: change freeze until 22:30 UTC, we have slack time for triage but escalate to oncall if SLO breach continues.

Leo: opening ticket RED-1301 with linked synth job 3509998888-tgt1 and pcap + logs, assigning to runtime/perf.

Nina: posting to #status: brief note sent, tagging impacted customers.

Leo: follow-up plan: 1) confirm no residual 504s after pin 2) analyze pcaps/strace 3) test a trimmed canary with connection timeout bump on node-07/09 4) propose a fix or rollback if root cause is code-level.

Teg: +1. I'll start correlating connection resets to upstream backends and GRPC timeouts.

Leo: thanks all. Closing this thread and moving discussion to RED-1301 for the postmortem. Will reopen here if we need a fast re-roll. :white_check_mark:
